verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair question for hardware security keys, since some keys in this category ship CLI tooling for scripted use. The evidence pack documents only interactive, human-in-the-loop use: enrolling, signing in, resetting and pairing. The runtime probe explicitly states Titan ships no vendor CLI, SDK, API or MCP surface, so there is no evidence it can run headlessly or in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
